citation: Singh, Pal. Report on the 68-bus, 16-machine, 5-area system (IEEE PES TF on Benchmark Systems for Stability Controls, v3.3)
what_it_documents: network, sub-transient machines, DC4B/ST1A/manual excitation, speed PSS; governors ignored (constant mechanical torque); D = 0
gap_or_consequence_for_CDW: the documented benchmark has no primary-frequency dynamics; CDW68 adds them from PST (documented) and runs the published model as ablation C

citation: Canizares et al. Benchmark Models for the Analysis and Control of Small-Signal Oscillatory Dynamics in Power Systems
what_it_documents: 68-bus system (Benchmark 6) validated in MATLAB and PacDyn; disturbance case (b): 50 MVAr reactor at bus 3 for 10 s; no governor model
gap_or_consequence_for_CDW: CDW68 TDS disturbance is case (b); confirms that no governor data are part of the validated benchmark

citation: Chow, Cheung. A toolbox for power system dynamics and control engineering education and research
what_it_documents: Power System Toolbox; its data16m.m documents machine ratings, equivalent-machine damping and a (commented) steam-reheat governor block for the 68-bus system
gap_or_consequence_for_CDW: source of the REAL variant's governors and damping; no dynamic claim

citation: Sandia National Laboratories. PSTess (Power and Energy Storage Systems Toolbox), tg.m
what_it_documents: exact PST tg model-1 equations and initialization
gap_or_consequence_for_CDW: equations transcribed in code/_r68.Gov68 and code/andes68/cdw68_models.py

citation: Gautam, Vittal, Harbour. Impact of increased penetration of DFIG-based wind turbine generators on transient and small signal stability of power systems
what_it_documents: some electromechanical modes improve and others degrade as synchronous generation is displaced
gap_or_consequence_for_CDW: on IEEE-68 CDW68 finds only one-sided (destabilizing) EM effects of replacement, consistent with mode-dependent but not context-reversing effects

citation: Quintero, Vittal, Heydt, Zhang. The impact of increased penetration of converter control-based generators on power system modes of oscillation
what_it_documents: increasing converter penetration changes participation in inter-area modes and adds converter-dominated modes (WECC cases)
gap_or_consequence_for_CDW: scenario-level evidence; no nested-portfolio or reinforcement-ranking test

citation: Eftekharnejad, Vittal, Heydt, Keel, Loehr. Small signal stability assessment of power systems with increased penetration of photovoltaic generation: a case study
what_it_documents: case study in which PV penetration affects the damping of critical modes
gap_or_consequence_for_CDW: scenario-level; supports treating replacement effects as system-dependent

citation: Agrawal, Huang, Fan, Huang. Analysis of the impact of the increasing inverter-based resources on inter-area modes of the U.S. Eastern Interconnection
relevance_to_replication: large-interconnection IBR impact on inter-area modes
what_it_documents: planning-case analysis of inter-area mode changes with IBR growth
gap_or_consequence_for_CDW: large-system scenario evidence; no context-reversal test

citation: Conte, Mancilla-David, Silvestro, Grillo. Small-signal stability manifolds in converter-dominated power systems
what_it_documents: stability boundaries over controller parameters and operating scenarios; sensitivity grows with inverter share
gap_or_consequence_for_CDW: dependence on share and controllers rather than on which units are replaced; no reinforcement ranking
